compounddef.initializer: template<typename T> concept gl::traits::c_graph_repr_tag = c_one_of<T, repr::list_t, repr::flat_list_t, repr::matrix_t, repr::flat_matrix_t>

briefdescription.para: Validates if a type is one of the defined graph representation tags.

detaileddescription.para: This concept is used to constrain template parameters that are expected to be specific graph representation tags, ensuring type safety and clear intent in template usage.

The valid tags include:
repr::list_t: Represents a standard adjacency list representation.
repr::flat_list_t: Represents a flattened adjacency list representation.
repr::matrix_t: Represents a standard adjacency matrix representation.
repr::flat_matrix_t: Represents a flattened adjacency matrix representation.

parameterdescription.para: The type to evaluate against the concept.
